04

Typography

Large Heading · Inter 300

The modern capital platform.
Allowing you to grow on your terms.

Section Heading · Inter 400

Unlock your biggest assets. Learn how our trading platform works.

Type Scale · Inter — single family, variable weight

56px300The modern capital platform.
40px300–400Unlock your biggest assets.
28px400Built to scale as your business grows
18px400Pipe transforms your future revenue streams into up-front capital.
14px300–400Just connect, click, and capitalize. Our fast, frictionless process takes hours, not months.
11px500Modern Liquidity Platform · Scale · Access · Operate

Key observation

Pipe uses a single typeface (Inter) across the entire site with no serifs. Headings use weight 300 (light) for large display text, letting size create hierarchy rather than bold weight. Body text sits at 400. Only labels and eyebrow text use 500+ weight with uppercase tracking.

05

Motion Language

→
Fade Up Reveal
Elements enter from below on scroll. Staggered children with 100ms delays create a cascading feel that reads as intelligent and deliberate.
On Scroll
◎
Radial Glow Hover
Cards emit a soft violet glow on hover via box-shadow with cubic-bezier easing. Communicates responsiveness without distraction.
On Hover
⇆
Tab Slider
Active tab indicator slides horizontally with ease-in-out. Pill transitions create spatial continuity between states.
On Select
▣
3D Object Float
Hero 3D shapes slowly rotate and drift on the grid backdrop. Reinforces the future-forward fintech brand voice.
Ambient
↔
Speed Lines
Background light streaks sweep horizontally to simulate momentum — aligned with "capital at velocity" messaging.
Decorative
▽
Data Counter Tick
Numeric values animate upward on entry. Reinforces trust and transparency in financial reporting.
On Load

Secondary: Outlined ghost style

Data Cards
Rating badges (AAA, BB, C) with color
IRR percentage indicator

50/50 split: text left, UI right
Feature card grid (2x2 bento style)
Numbered progress tab bar
Full-width footer with columns
07

Brand Voice & Tone

Confident

"The modern capital platform." No qualifiers. Declarative statements that establish authority from the first word.

Empowering

"Grow on your terms." "Without dilution." The copy hands control back to the business owner. Autonomy is the benefit.

Precise

$930,969.86 · 3.44% ROI · 12 months. Real data, not vague promises. Numbers always visible, never hidden.
